question: In Warframe, compare the critical chance of the Soma Prime and the Braton Prime (normal attack).
answer:
**Soma Prime has the higher critical chance: 30%, against 12% for Braton Prime. That is 18 percentage points more, or 2.5 times as much.**

Source: the Warframe Wiki pages for [Soma Prime](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Soma_Prime) and [Braton Prime](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Braton_Prime). Both figures are the base normal-attack values. I only read the first part of each page, and the Fandom pages returned errors.
reason: The candidate gives Soma Prime 30% and Braton Prime 12% critical chance, matching both expected values exactly.
